# tenant-property API reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/documentation.cjs. Do not edit. -->

Read legacy StorageEntity values from a caller-selected tenant app catalog.

## SPFxTenantProperty

Deserialized StorageEntity value and description. T is a compile-time expectation, not runtime validation; legacy serialization may coerce JSON-like strings.

### Imports

```ts
import type { SPFxTenantProperty } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import type { SPFxTenantProperty } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/services';
```

### Examples

```ts
import { SPFxTenantProperty, SPFxTenantPropertyService } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';

async function exampleUsage(catalogUrl: string, service: SPFxTenantPropertyService) {
  const property: SPFxTenantProperty<boolean> = await service.get('featureEnabled', catalogUrl);
  console.log(property.value);
}
```

### Type parameters

- `T`: Expected application data shape; defaults to unknown and performs no runtime validation.

### Type

```ts
interface SPFxTenantProperty<T = unknown>
```

### Members

| Member | Type | Requirement | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `SPFxTenantProperty.description` | `string \| undefined` | Required, readonly | — | Stored description passed through unchanged when Value exists; undefined when Value is missing/legacy REST null, even if a description was supplied. |
| `SPFxTenantProperty.value` | `T \| undefined` | Required, readonly | — | Deserialized value, or undefined when SharePoint returns no Value or a legacy REST-null Value. A stored string is parsed JSON-first without schema validation or Date reconstruction. |

## SPFxTenantPropertyService

Reads StorageEntity properties from an explicitly supplied tenant app catalog. No discovery, cache, provisioning or write method is added.

### Imports (2)

```ts
import type { SPFxTenantPropertyService } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import type { SPFxTenantPropertyService } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/services';
```

### Examples (2)

```ts
import type { SPHttpClient } from '@microsoft/sp-http';
import { SPFxTenantPropertyService, createSPFxTenantPropertyService } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';

async function exampleUsage(client: SPHttpClient, catalogUrl: string) {
  const service: SPFxTenantPropertyService = createSPFxTenantPropertyService(client);
  const setting = await service.get<boolean>('featureEnabled', catalogUrl);
}
```

### Members (2)

| Member | Type | Requirement | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `SPFxTenantPropertyService.get` | `<T = unknown>(key: string, catalogUrl: string) => Promise<SPFxTenantProperty<T>>` | Required | — | Reads and deserializes one StorageEntity. |

#### SPFxTenantPropertyService.get (2)

##### Throws

- Every unsuccessful HTTP response, including 404/403, and response parsing failures; HTTP failure is never an absent-property success.

##### Type parameters (2)

- `T`: Expected deserialized value; defaults to unknown and performs no runtime validation.

##### Parameters

- `key`: Required property key; OData-escaped and URL-encoded for the path.
- `catalogUrl`: Absolute tenant app catalog URL.

##### Returns

Value and description, possibly undefined.

## createSPFxTenantPropertyService

Creates explicit StorageEntity reads without discovering the catalog.

### Imports (3)

```ts
import { createSPFxTenantPropertyService } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import { createSPFxTenantPropertyService } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/services';
```

### Use when

- You read existing StorageEntity values from an already known tenant catalog.

### Examples (3)

#### Basic usage

```ts
import type { WebPartContext } from '@microsoft/sp-webpart-base';
import { createSPFxTenantPropertyService } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';

async function exampleUsage(context: WebPartContext, catalogUrl: string) {
  const service = createSPFxTenantPropertyService(context.spHttpClient);
  const setting = await service.get<string>('appVersion', catalogUrl);
}
```

#### Read and validate an unknown StorageEntity

```ts
import type { SPHttpClient } from '@microsoft/sp-http';

import { createSPFxTenantPropertyService } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
async function demonstrate(context: { spHttpClient: SPHttpClient }, catalogUrl: string) {
  const service = createSPFxTenantPropertyService(context.spHttpClient);
  const property = await service.get<unknown>('my-app:featureEnabled', catalogUrl);
  if (typeof property.value === 'boolean') console.log(property.value);
}
```

### Signatures (2)

```ts
(spHttpClient: SPHttpClient): SPFxTenantPropertyService
```

#### Parameters (3)

- `spHttpClient`: Caller-owned SharePoint client.

#### Returns (3)

A property-reading service; construction performs no request.
